# Saini Tubewell Boring Service (STBS)

> Borewell and tubewell contractor in Sonipat, Haryana, since 1992. Water testing up to 800 m, borewell drilling (150–300 mm bores), tubewell construction, borewell material supply and rainwater harvesting for industrial, institutional, commercial and agricultural sites across Haryana and Delhi NCR.

## Services
- [Water testing](https://www.stbs.in/water-testing): ground survey up to 800 m before drilling (water-bearing zones, drilling point and depth, written report); yield, water-level and water-quality tests after drilling.
- [Borewell drilling](https://www.stbs.in/borewell-drilling): own rotary rigs; 150–300 mm bores; uPVC casing 100–500 mm, 10 kg/cm², ISI marked; development until the water runs clear and sand-free.
- [Tubewell construction](https://www.stbs.in/tubewell-construction): casing, slotted filter pipe, gravel pack, stainless-steel submersible pump, HDPE rising main, cable, starter panel, well-head, testing and handover.
- [Borewell material supply](https://www.stbs.in/borewell-material-supply): uPVC casing pipes, slotted filter pipes, SS submersible pumps 1–50 HP, HDPE delivery pipes, 3-core copper cable, automatic starter panels, well-head fittings, filter gravel. Brands include Supreme, Kisan, Jindal, Reliance, CRI, Crompton, Field Marshal, Finolex, Polycab, L&T and Bentex.
- [Rainwater harvesting](https://www.stbs.in/rainwater-harvesting): recharge bores with slotted pipe and gravel pack, RCC recharge chambers with cover slab and overflow, silt and filter chambers.

## Company
- [About](https://www.stbs.in/about): founded in 1992 by Rajesh Saini; 34+ years in the field.
- [Clients](https://www.stbs.in/clients): 22+ organisations across industry, education, real estate and healthcare, including Amul (Murthal), BigBasket (Sonipat), voestalpine, LT Foods (Dawat), Ashoka University, O.P. Jindal Global University, Coral Drugs and Rishi Laser.
- [Projects](https://www.stbs.in/projects): rainwater harvesting for the BigBasket distribution centre (Kundli), paired 300 mm percolation boreholes up to 40 m at Ashoka University, and an industrial recharge pit at HSIIDC Barhi.
